items.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
items.content: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

items.title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
items.content: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

items.title: Lighter pauses withdrawals after reported $10M account theft
items.content: Lighter has paused withdrawals after reporting a leaked trader API key, with Bubblemaps tracking $10.4 million withdrawn.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
items.content: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

items.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
items.content: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.

items.title: Binance Pay Later offers credit backed by Bitcoin, Ether and BNB holdings
items.content: Eligible users can access up to 1,000 USDC in credit against their Bitcoin, Ether or BNB for purchases via Binance Card or QR Pay.

items.title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
items.content: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.

items.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border FX settlement with CBDCs
items.content: Project Simbolon aims to reduce the cost and time of cross-border settlement and promote common standards for payments and FX

items.title: BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.content: Bitcoin traders awaited Nvidia Q3 earnings after BTC price selling pressure saw a dip below $62,000 at the weekend.

items.title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
items.content: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

items.title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
items.content: Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.

items.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
items.content: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

items.title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
items.content: The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.

items.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack
items.content: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

items.title: Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia comeback days after shock exit: FT
items.content: Silicon Valley executives are reportedly organizing a campaign to bring Huang back and are looking to gain White House support.

items.title: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest
items.content: Anchorage Digital data suggests the Bitcoin selloff is being driven by US investors. A “war room” has been set up by supporters to reinstate Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.

items.title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
items.content: With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to 4-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.content: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

items.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
items.content: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.

items.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down 3 years after $2.3B TVL peak
items.content: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.

items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
items.content: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
items.content: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

items.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
items.content: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

items.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
items.content: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
items.content: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

items.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
items.content: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

items.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
items.content: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

items.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
items.content: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.
